problem.description: Control tren toolbar va hai o tuy chon Sidebar dinh/chong nhau khi thu nho cua so ung dung.
symptoms: Nhan nut toolbar bi ep thanh nhieu dong va tran khoi thanh cao 64 px.
Hai select OCR/table ep grid vuot qua chieu rong Sidebar.

hypotheses.description: Toolbar co chieu cao co dinh va flex item duoc shrink/break text.
Grid Sidebar thieu min-w-0/w-full va khong doi layout theo chieu rong.

tests_run.output: Do hinh hoc direct children cua toolbar/sidebar; khong overlap va khong overflow sau fix.

tests_run.command: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:e2e

tests_run.output: Chi con intentional sequential batch warning.

findings: Toolbar dung h-16 va mot flex row, trong khi tong min-content rong hon main pane.
Button khong co whitespace-nowrap/flex-none nen label bi be tung dong.
Select la grid item co min-width auto nen noi dung option ep cot tran khoi Sidebar.

resolution.root_cause: Fixed-height single-row toolbar cho phep shrink text; Sidebar grid khong co min-size constraints/container-width fallback.
resolution.fix_applied: Toolbar flex-wrap theo whole controls voi min-height auto; button nowrap/flex-none; main pane min-w-0; Sidebar select w-full/min-w-0 va grid mot cot duoi 260 px; source button luon hien.
resolution.verification: Lint/build, React Doctor changed scope va 5 Electron E2E pass, gom geometry test 820x700.
